```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

The following tables display the Pearson correlations between ingroup bias and ideology in all conditions in all studies. This is the raw data for the meta-analysis reported in the main manuscript, where these correlations were transformed to Fisher's $z$.


```{r echo=FALSE}
# Read data

nhbmeta <- read.csv('../../data/metadata_processed.csv')

# Create tables

kable(nhbmeta[, c("study", "group", colnames(nhbmeta)[grep("cor_Bias", colnames(nhbmeta))])],
      digits = 2, 
      caption = "Correlation between Bias (combined measure) and Ideology", 
      col.names = c("Study", "Group", "Bias ~ Ideology", "Bias ~ Self-Reported Ideology", "Bias ~ Issue-Based Ideology")) %>% kable_styling(position = "left")

kable(nhbmeta[, c("study", "group", colnames(nhbmeta)[grep("cor_Traits", colnames(nhbmeta))])],
      digits = 2, 
      caption = "Correlation between Bias (Traits) and Ideology", 
      col.names = c("Study", "Group", "Bias ~ Ideology", "Bias ~ Self-Reported Ideology", "Bias ~ Issue-Based Ideology")) %>% kable_styling(position = "left")
```
